title: Precision reference
description: From a 10V supply, produce a 2.500V +/-0.2% reference at node 'vref' driving a fixed 10k load. Required exactly: 'V1 vin 0 DC 10', a 100 ohm sense resistor 'Rsense vin top 100', and 'Rload vref 0 10k'. Total supply current must not exceed 1.5mA (drop across Rsense at most 0.15V). Build the divider from 'top' to 'vref' to ground. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
